scenes.title: Intelligent Infinity
scenes.subtitle: Infinity became aware of itself — the first knowing.

scenes.title: The One Creator
scenes.subtitle: The infinite is one. Many-ness is a finite concept.

scenes.title: First Density
scenes.subtitle: First density: the awareness of being — mineral, water, fire, wind.

scenes.title: Red Ray
scenes.subtitle: Wakefulness without self-reference. The foundation.

scenes.title: Second Density
scenes.subtitle: Second density: growth and striving toward the light.

scenes.title: Orange Ray
scenes.subtitle: Movement, desire, the beginning of individuation.

scenes.title: Third Density
scenes.subtitle: Third density: the first consciousness of spirit.

scenes.title: Yellow Ray
scenes.subtitle: Self-consciousness — and the first choice between STO and STS.

scenes.title: The Veil
scenes.subtitle: Forgetting is the tool — without it, choice would not be real.

scenes.title: Fourth Density
scenes.subtitle: Fourth density: love — the green ray.

scenes.title: Green Ray
scenes.subtitle: Variable physicality — consciousness becomes group.

scenes.title: The Heart
scenes.subtitle: From green ray onward, the heart opens into service.

scenes.title: Fifth Density
scenes.subtitle: Fifth density: wisdom — the blue ray.

scenes.title: Blue Ray
scenes.subtitle: Light and knowledge merged — compassion through understanding.

scenes.title: Sixth Density
scenes.subtitle: Sixth density: balance — the indigo ray.

scenes.title: Indigo Ray
scenes.subtitle: STO and STS reconciled — the gateway to intelligent infinity.

scenes.title: Seventh Density
scenes.subtitle: Seventh density: unity — the violet ray.

scenes.title: Violet Ray
scenes.subtitle: Union with the One — timeless — the turning to the next octave.

scenes.title: The Octave
scenes.subtitle: Eight densities form a great octave — the eighth begins the next.

scenes.title: Sub-Densities
scenes.subtitle: Within each density are seven sub-densities — infinite recursion.

scenes.title: The Prism
scenes.subtitle: White light splits into rays — one source, infinite expressions.

scenes.title: One Light
scenes.subtitle: All colors are the same light — all densities are one consciousness.

scenes.title: The Harvest
scenes.subtitle: Those finishing the cycle are sorted by their own vibration.

scenes.title: No Judgment
scenes.subtitle: There is no judgment — only resonance. You choose your destination.

scenes.title: Closing
scenes.subtitle: You are the Creator experiencing Itself. The journey is the destination.

scenes.title: Final Frame
scenes.subtitle: All is One. One is All. You are That.
